description: This file defines a StatusActivityBuilder enum with a static build method that constructs and returns a StatusPill.Activity based on various properties of a NodeAppModel instance and input parameters. It determines the current status to display, such as background state, gateway repair or approval, screen recording, camera HUD status, and voice wake permissions, and creates corresponding activity indicators.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a StatusPill.Activity object based on app model state and input parameters, indicating various statuses such as background, gateway issues, recording, camera HUD, and voice wake conditions.
